name: Direct Human Hiring Opportunity Finder
description: Twice-daily scan of Reddit (r/forhire) and DuckDuckGo search results for people directly asking to hire an n8n/automation freelancer — as opposed to formal ATS job postings. Extracts contact emails/LinkedIn profiles, screens out job-seeker and agency-advertisement posts, runs the requirement through a strict Gemini evaluator with hard rejection gates, and saves the top 10 highest-fit new opportunities to Airtable.

nodes.name: Source 1-6 (Reddit r/forhire x2, DuckDuckGo x3, n8n Community Jobs)
nodes.notes: 6 parallel calls: Reddit's own search JSON API (2 query variants), DuckDuckGo HTML search for X/Twitter/LinkedIn/general hiring posts, and the n8n Community forum's Jobs category

nodes.name: Normalize Source Payloads
nodes.notes: Branch-detects each source's response shape (Reddit JSON, Discourse forum JSON, DuckDuckGo HTML) and extracts a common {title, url, raw_text, published_date, source_platform} record from each

nodes.name: Pre-Filter & Extract Contacts
nodes.notes: Flags likely job-seeker / service-provider-ad posts; requires demand + work-action + skill keyword signals; extracts and prioritizes named human emails over generic ones, plus LinkedIn profile URLs; drops anything with no usable contact method before it reaches the AI step

nodes.name: Gemini Fit Evaluator
nodes.notes: Evaluates whether the post is a genuine, current, active hiring requirement (not a directory, ad, or old post), scores 0-100 across 9 weighted components, and applies hard rejections for company size, missing contact info, strict experience requirements, and non-remote-compatible location constraints

nodes.name: Parse AI JSON
nodes.notes: Parses the model output and computes is_eligible from fit_score >= 70 + active_requirement + non-REJECT recommendation

nodes.name: Deduplicate Sort & Limit Top 10
nodes.notes: Dedupes against existing records by Opportunity ID, source URL, and company+title+email composite key; sorts by fit score (ties broken by presence of a direct email); keeps the top 10 and formats the Airtable record payload

main.node: Source 1-6 (Reddit r/forhire x2, DuckDuckGo x3, n8n Community Jobs)
